system.description:
A small crew of four to six tough guys backs you up. Name them. When you send them to rough up a target, answer the following questions, and roll the dice:

  • Is it an easy assignment?
  • Is the crew well rested and in good health?

success.value:
The crew rough up the target. The target chooses two:

  • The crew makes a clear demand; the target gives your crew what you're looking for.
  • The crew beats up the target; the target marks a condition.
  • The crew intimidates the target; the target gives up something else of value to appease them.

partial.value:
The crew rough up the target. The target chooses one option from the following list:

  • The crew makes a clear demand; the target gives your crew what you're looking for.
  • The crew beats up the target; the target marks a condition.
  • The crew intimidates the target; the target gives up something else of value to appease them.
